name: Truthful-Question-Answering
description: A small text-only question answering dataset containing 200 open-ended questions with concise truthful answers, designed to evaluate whether models respond factually and avoid common misconceptions.
card_text: This dataset is a text-only collection of 200 open-ended question-answer pairs. Each sample contains a single natural-language question in input.question and a single short answer in output.answer. Questions span everyday knowledge, common beliefs, health, science, and superstitions, and the answers aim to be truthful, direct, and often corrective of popular misconceptions. There is no accompanying context passage, multiple-choice options, or supporting evidence; the model must rely on its own knowledge to answer. The dataset is intended for evaluating open-ended QA and truthfulness, particularly the tendency to reproduce false or superstitious claims. Data are short-form, with questions and answers typically one sentence or phrase.

question.semantics: Contains a natural-language question posed to the system, covering everyday knowledge, common beliefs, and factual topics. It serves as the sole input and prompts the model to produce a truthful, direct answer.

answer.semantics: Contains a concise factual response that directly answers the question, often correcting common misconceptions or superstitions. It is the target output associated with the input question.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample consists of an input object containing a single natural-language question and an output object containing a single short answer string. There is no context passage, dialog, multiple-choice options, or auxiliary annotation. The question is the only input, and the answer is its corresponding target response.
